citations.claim: first violating step: body 0 state when controller force 214.479 exceeds limit 156.009
one step before, same regime but force was exactly at limit 156.009
two steps before, force still clamped at limit despite higher speed

counterfactual.change: reduced controller kp from 21.386 to 10.0 only; lowers velocity-error demand so clamp never saturates and violation disappears

explanation: Controller demand kp*velocity-error exceeds fmax for many steps and is correctly clamped at exactly fmax (steps 332-333). At step 334 with very similar state (speed slightly lower, 2 substeps, no contacts) the reported force 214.479 exceeds fmax 156.009, so the fmax clamp was bypassed/mis-scaled on that step (likely substep force accumulation or clamp applied per-substep but summed). Lowering kp removes saturation and removes failure.
vision_note: The red body hovers just below the green waypoint and drifts slightly downward from steps 331 to 334 while the blue body stays on the left and the vertical wall stays on the right. No contact, jump, or visible burst occurs at step 334.
